title: TenantGroupPractitionerSpecialty
description: Represents the specialty information for a healthcare provider.  References the Specialty entity.

effectiveDate.description: The date when the specialty became effective.

terminationDate.description: The date when the specialty was terminated.

isPrimary.description: Indicates if the specialty is primary.

isBoardCertified.description: Indicates if the practitioner is board certified in this specialty.

isPracticing.description: Indicates if the practitioner is currently practicing this specialty.

isContracted.description: Indicates if the practitioner is contracted for this specialty.
